[[Plains of Jarin]] | collector = y | henchman = y | merchant = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Champion's Dawn world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Champion's Dawn inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} [[Champion's Dawn]] is a long-standing mining camp near the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]], the source of all the quarried building material for the island nation of [[Istan]]. {{Quotation|game| Situated near the mineral-rich Cliffs of Dohjok, Champion's Dawn is the base of operations for the [[Istani Society of Engineers and Architects]]. The stone and gems quarried here have fueled Istani architecture for a millenium. The Primeval style has so deeply impacted modern Istani builders that the Society has a long-standing rivalry with the [[Excavation Corps]] over the status of the ruins to the west. }} ==Getting there== Champion's Dawn is located at the southwestern corner of the [[Plains of Jarin]]. The [[primary quest]] [[Leaving a Legacy]] will point players to this location.
